settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.text: Quick answers about orders, delivery and returns. Can't find what you need? Get in touch.

settings.heading: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.content: Payments are processed securely through Razorpay. You can pay with UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking and popular wallets.

settings.heading: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.content: Contact us within 2 hours of ordering and we'll do our best to help. Once an order has been dispatched it can't be changed, but you can return it under our returns policy.

settings.heading: Are prices inclusive of GST?
settings.content: Yes, all prices are in Indian Rupees and include applicable GST.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.content: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 working days and usually arrive in 3–7 working days, depending on your pin code.

settings.heading: How much is shipping?
settings.content: Shipping is free on orders above ₹2,999. A flat ₹99 applies to smaller orders.

settings.heading: How do I track my order?
settings.content: We'll email and SMS a tracking link as soon as your order ships.

settings.heading: What is your returns policy?
settings.content: Unused items with original tags can be returned within 7 days of delivery. See our Shipping & Returns page for details.

settings.heading: When will I get my refund?
settings.content: Refunds are made to your original payment method through Razorpay within 5–7 working days of your return being approved.

settings.heading: My item arrived damaged. What now?
settings.content: We're sorry! Email us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and photos, and we'll arrange a replacement or full refund.

settings.heading: Still have a question?
settings.text: Our team replies within one working day, Monday to Saturday.
